summary: System1, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the filing of a Certificate of Designation creating Series A Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock and the election of a director by preferred shareholders. The filing discloses the creation of 39,250 preferred shares with an initial stated value of $1,022.05 per share, reflecting a $1,000 liquidation preference plus accrued dividends. It also notes that Robert Sharp was elected to the board by preferred stock holders. This filing does not disclose a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other transformative event. It is a routine disclosure of charter amendments and a board appointment.
